what: In pictures: Trump hosted by Xi Jinping in Beijing on two-day summit

clean_source_blocks.text: President Trump was welcomed by President Xi Jinping in Beijing for what will be a whirlwind tour.

Donald Trump and Xi Jinping have been holding talks in the Chinese capital, Beijing, with a raft of meetings and events taking place on Thursday and Friday. The US leader was greeted with a gun salute, cheering children and a tour of the stunning 15th Century Temple of Heaven. Trump is also joined in Beijing by tech bosses, including Tesla's Elon Musk and Nvidia's Jensen Huang, and Trump's son Eric. Landing in Air Force One on Wednesday evening, Trump was greeted by youths waving American and Chinese flags as he walked the red carpet with Vice President of China Han Zheng. On Thursday, Trump was welcomed at an arrival ceremony with Xi at China's Great Hall of the People. After shaking hands, Trump and Xi walked the red carpet and inspected Chinese troops who lined up in impeccably neat rows.

BEIJING — President Trump arrived in China Wednesday for a summit with President Xi Jinping — promising to call on the Asian power to “open up” to American businesses after last year’s trade war. Trump received a red-carpet tarmac welcome from Xi’s vice president, Han Zheng, before his high-power entourage clamored down the steps of Air Force One. About 300 children sang a welcome message and waved US and Chinese flags as Trump greeted the crowd with his signature fist pumps. Follow The Post’s live coverage of President Trump and national politics for the latest news and analysis Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, the world’s richest man, and CEO Jensen Huang of Nvidia, the world’s largest business by market capitalization, followed Trump down the stairs, as did first son Eric Trump, who has a lead...

US President Donald Trump on Thursday told China’s Xi Jinping their countries would have “a fantastic future together”, as they began a superpower summit in Beijing on thorny issues including Iran, trade and Taiwan. Heaping praise on his host, Trump told Xi it was “an honour to be your friend”, as the Chinese leader, in less effusive tones, said the two sides “should be partners and not rivals”. Xi had greeted Trump with a red carpet welcome at the opulent Great Hall of the People with military band fanfare, a gun salute and a host of schoolchildren jumping and chanting “welcome!”. Header image: Chinese President Xi Jinping attends a welcome ceremony with US President Donald Trump at the Great Hall of the People, in Beijing, China, May 14, 2026. —Reuters ---

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Donald Trump and Xi Jinping have been holding talks in the Chinese capital, Beijing, with a raft of meetings and events taking place on Thursday and Friday.

The US leader was greeted with a gun salute, cheering children and a tour of the stunning 15th Century Temple of Heaven.

Trump is also joined in Beijing by tech bosses, including Tesla's Elon Musk and Nvidia's Jensen Huang, and Trump's son Eric.

Landing in Air Force One on Wednesday evening, Trump was greeted by youths waving American and Chinese flags as he walked the red carpet with Vice President of China Han Zheng.

On Thursday, Trump was welcomed at an arrival ceremony with Xi at China's Great Hall of the People.

After shaking hands, Trump and Xi walked the red carpet and inspected Chinese troops who lined up in impeccably neat rows.

Dozens of children also lined up along the red carpet and waved mini flags and bouquets.

Joining Trump on his trip to China are some of the US's top business leaders, including Tim Cook of Apple, Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX, and Larry Fink of BlackRock.

Jensen Huang, the boss of Nvidia, a company which has been central to the US-China technology rivalry, was reportedly a last-minute addition.

The leaders then held highly anticipated bilateral talks in the Great Hall of the People.

In his opening remarks, Xi noted that "the whole world is watching our meeting.

"Currently transformation not seen in a century is accelerating across the globe and the international situation is fluid and turbulent".

Trump added that it was "an honour" to be meeting Xi.

"We've gotten along, when there were difficulties we worked it out. I would call you and you would call me," Trump said.

"People don't know, whenever we had a problem we worked it out very quickly."

After two hours of talks, the leaders then visited the Temple of Heaven, an ancient complex of temples in Beijing and a major tourist attraction.

The historic site is where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties would offer sacrifices and pray for bountiful harvests.

"Great place, incredible," Trump said to Xi as the two presidents posed for a photo at the Temple of Heaven, in front of the iconic main hall. "China's beautiful."

payload.title: Trump ja Xi aloittivat kaksipäiväisen huippukokouksen Pekingissä
payload.summary: Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump on aloittanut Kiinan presidentin Xi Jinpingin isännöimän kaksipäiväisen vierailun Pekingissä. Ohjelmaan kuuluu tapaamisia ja seremonioita, ja neuvottelujen aiheiksi on mainittu kauppa, Taiwan ja Iran.
payload.content:
Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump on saapunut Pekingiin kaksipäiväiseen huippukokoukseen Kiinan presidentin Xi Jinpingin kanssa. Vierailu alkoi näyttävillä vastaanottoseremonioilla, ja torstain sekä perjantain ohjelmaan kuuluu useita tapaamisia ja tapahtumia, joiden yhteydessä johtajien odotetaan käsittelevän muun muassa kauppaa, Taiwania ja Irania.

## Näyttävä vastaanotto Pekingissä

Trump saapui Kiinaan keskiviikkoiltana Air Force Onella. Lentokentällä häntä oli vastassa Kiinan varapresidentti Han Zheng. Vastaanottoon kuului punainen matto, ja paikalla olleet nuoret heiluttivat Yhdysvaltain ja Kiinan lippuja Trumpin kulkiessa väkijoukon ohi.

Torstaina Trump ja Xi tapasivat Pekingin Kansan suuressa salissa. Seremoniaan kuului sotilassoittokunta, kunnialaukauksia ja koululaisia, jotka tervehtivät vierasta. Johtajat kättelivät, kulkivat punaisella matolla ja tarkastivat paikalle järjestäytyneitä kiinalaisjoukkoja.

Vierailuohjelmaan on liitetty myös kierros 1400-luvulla rakennetulla Taivaan temppelillä, joka on yksi Pekingin tunnetuista historiallisista kohteista. Kokonaisuus korostaa sitä, että kyse ei ole vain neuvotteluista, vaan myös tarkkaan rakennetusta valtiovierailun seremoniallisesta kehyksestä.

## Kauppa, Taiwan ja Iran neuvottelujen aiheina

Huippukokouksen taustalla ovat Yhdysvaltojen ja Kiinan väliset jännitteet. Esillä oleviksi aiheiksi on mainittu kauppa, Taiwan ja Iran. Trumpin kerrotaan aikovan vaatia Kiinaa avaamaan markkinoitaan yhdysvaltalaisille yrityksille aiempien kauppakiistojen jälkeen.

Tapaamisen alussa Trump kuvaili maiden yhteistä tulevaisuutta hyvin myönteisesti ja kiitti Xiä isännöinnistä. Xi puolestaan sanoi, että maiden tulisi olla kumppaneita eikä kilpailijoita. Lausuntojen sävy oli sovitteleva, vaikka käsiteltävät kysymykset ovat vaikeita.

## Liike-elämän edustajat mukana

Trumpin mukana Pekingissä on myös liike-elämän edustajia. Lähteissä mainitaan Teslan Elon Musk ja Nvidian Jensen Huang. Lisäksi mukana on Trumpin poika Eric Trump. Talousjohtajien läsnäolo korostaa vierailun kaupallista painoarvoa.

Kaksipäiväinen kokous jatkuu perjantaina. Toistaiseksi ei ole kerrottu, johtavatko keskustelut konkreettisiin päätöksiin tai uusiin avauksiin maiden suhteissa.

Trump is also joined in Beijing by tech bosses, including Tesla's Elon Musk and Nvidia's Jensen Huang, and Trump's son Eric. Landing in Air Force One on Wednesday evening, Trump was greeted by youths waving American and Chinese flags as he walked the red carpet with Vice President of China Han Zheng. On Thursday, Trump was welcomed at an arrival ceremony with Xi at China's Great Hall of the People. After shaking hands, Trump and Xi walked the red carpet and inspected Chinese troops who lined up in impeccably neat rows.

BEIJING — President Trump arrived in China Wednesday for a summit with President Xi Jinping — promising to call on the Asian power to “open up” to American businesses after last year’s trade war. Trump received a red-carpet tarmac welcome from Xi’s vice president, Han Zheng, before his high-power entourage clamored down the steps of Air Force One. About 300 children sang a welcome message and waved US and Chinese flags as Trump greeted the crowd with his signature fist pumps. US President Donald Trump on Thursday told China’s Xi Jinping their countries would have “a fantastic future together”, as they began a superpower summit in Beijing on thorny issues including Iran, trade and Taiwan. Heaping praise on his host, Trump told Xi it was “an honour to be your friend”, as the Chinese leader, in less effusive tones, said the two sides “should be partners and not rivals”. Xi had greeted Trump with a red carpet welcome at the opulent Great Hall of the People with military band fanfare, a gun salute and a host of schoolchildren jumping and chanting “welcome!”.
